title: TotalSegmentator test scans
about: Small test scans from TotalSegmentator's own repository, downsampled to 3 mm voxels. A CT from the lower chest to the upper thighs, a 30-slice crop of the same CT, and a short MR crop. Each is paired with the multilabel segmentation that has the same grid.
credit: Wasserthal et al., TotalSegmentator. github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator, tests/reference_files, Apache-2.0 repository, commit c59be95b.
licence: Apache-2.0 (repository licence; the files carry no separate notice)
notice: Illustrative test data. Not for diagnosis.
warning: example_ct.nii.gz and example_seg.nii.gz share an affine but not a grid: example_seg has 30 slices and matches slices 82 to 111 of example_ct, which is exactly example_ct_sm. Pairing those two puts the organs in the wrong place, so they are not paired here.
